country.evidence_quote: The company is a small, independent family owned and operated enterprise which started in Mike Collins’ garage in 1992. Today, Advantage operates in an 18,000 square foot factory based in Santa Ana, California and is a family affair with Lyann and their son, Eben managing the business with Mike. Advantage owns its own tooling and proudly produces their products here in the USA.
